verdict.rationale: Prompt/prefix caching is a fair question for an LLM inference API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents prompt or prefix caching on Groq. Batch discounts, flex/service tiers and raw token-speed reports are adjacent cost and latency features, not caching of repeated context, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can benefit from prompt/prefix caching that reduces latency or cost on repeated context
